title: Make a controller action
summary: ASP.NET Web API: Make a controller action. Change the greeting.
introduction: A controller action handles a route. HttpGet maps GET /hello to the method.
learningObjectives: Make a controller action with ASP.NET Web API

blocks.text: Install the .NET SDK. Run dotnet new web -n SchoolApi and enter it. Replace Program.cs with one example. Run dotnet run --urls http://127.0.0.1:8000. These examples use controllers without a database.

blocks.title: Make a controller action

blocks.text: AddControllers registers controller services and MapControllers uses their route attributes. Hello returns text.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: AddControllers and MapControllers are both needed.
